key: {"audience": "University (ages 20+)", "learner_profile": "Need foundations and step-by-step support", "section_titles": ["Unwrapping the Rings", "The Triangle Emerges"]}

candidates.title: Rolled Carpet Unfurling
candidates.description: A circular braided rug seen from above, made of concentric fabric rings stitched together. As we cut and unroll each ring, the fabric strips lay out horizontally and stack vertically, revealing how the spiral construction creates a triangular pile when fully unfurled.

candidates.title: Tree Trunk Growth Rings
candidates.description: A cross-section of a tree trunk showing annual growth rings. We peel each ring like bark strips, straightening them out and stacking them by age, with the oldest (widest circumference) at the bottom and youngest at top, forming a triangular wood-grain pattern that reveals the tree's accumulated growth.

candidates.title: Cinnamon Roll Slicing
candidates.description: A cinnamon roll viewed from the side, showing its spiral swirl of dough. As we unroll the pastry, each coil becomes a strip of dough laid flat, and when stacked by length (longest coils at bottom), the layers form a triangular cross-section revealing the mathematical structure hidden in the spiral.
